title: Detail Panel Tree Layout System
description: Implement TreeRow and HelperRow convenience components, add vertical spacing to tree containers, and migrate all TreeItem+TreeContent patterns to TreeRow across Design.tsx, Kit.tsx, Quality.tsx, Type.tsx, Home.tsx, and Docs.tsx
summary: Implemented TreeRow/HelperRow components in elements.tsx, migrated 100+ TreeItem+TreeContent patterns to TreeRow across 6 files, added vertical spacing (gap-y-[2px]) to tree containers, updated TreeRow to support id/onClick/onDoubleClick/actions props. TypeScript compiles (only pre-existing errors). All 13 JS tests pass.
